cues.en: Okay, imagine this is a timeline.
cues.zh: 好，想像這是一條時間軸。

cues.en: Here we are in the present, and what we want to do is predict what's going to happen in the future.
cues.zh: 這裡是現在，我們想預測未來會發生什麼事。

cues.en: And not just llms, but that's basically what all of biology is trying to do.
cues.zh: 不只是 LLM，基本上所有生物也都在做這件事。

cues.en: Anticipate what's going to happen in the future.
cues.zh: 也就是預先判斷未來會發生什麼事。

cues.en: But of course, we cannot actually know what's going to happen in the future.
cues.zh: 但當然，我們不可能真的知道未來。

cues.en: We just make an informed guess.
cues.zh: 只能根據資訊來猜測。

cues.en: And where does that information come from?
cues.zh: 資訊從哪裡來？

cues.en: Well, it mainly comes from the past.
cues.zh: 主要來自過去。

cues.en: So we use to try to predict the future.
cues.zh: 所以我們用過去，試著預測未來。

cues.en: Fair enough.
cues.zh: 很合理。

cues.en: How can we mathematically represent this process of accumulating and integrating information from the past?
cues.zh: 要如何用數學表示這個累積、整合過去資訊的過程？

cues.en: Well, we could think about a vector that would look something like this.
cues.zh: 可以想像一個像這樣的向量。

cues.en: So all of these time points in the past and the present are given a value of one.
cues.zh: 過去與現在的所有時間點，都給值 1。

cues.en: And the future is given a value of zero.
cues.zh: 未來則給值 0。

cues.en: This way when we consider these numbers to be activations referring to some information from the past,
cues.zh: 這樣把這些數字視為對應過去資訊的活化值時，

cues.en: Then the weighted sum of the past and the present is going to hopefully identify some patterns or trends that allows us to predict the future.
cues.zh: 過去與現在的加權總和，就有機會找出某些模式或趨勢，讓我們預測未來。

cues.en: But there is a problem with these activation values.
cues.zh: 但這些活化值有個問題。

cues.en: The problem is that they have a sum greater than one, and we don't want that in numerical calculations for a variety of reasons, including avoiding numerical instabilities.
cues.zh: 它們的總和大於 1，而出於多種理由，包括避免數值不穩定，我們不希望數值計算出現這樣的情況。

cues.en: But that's no problem.
cues.zh: 不過沒關係。

cues.en: We can just have a minor adjustment here and say that the activation value for each time point is one divided by the sum over all the values.
cues.zh: 稍微調整一下，把每個時間點的活化值，設為 1 除以所有值的總和。

cues.en: And of course, the future is still weighted at zero.
cues.zh: 當然，未來的權重仍然是零。

cues.en: Now that's fine, but we don't necessarily want to wait every time point in the past.
cues.zh: 這樣沒問題，但不一定想對過去每個時間點都給

cues.en: Equally, maybe some time points in the past are more important or more relevant than others.
cues.zh: 相同權重。有些過去時間點可能比較重要，或比較相關。

cues.en: So perhaps we want to have an activation vector that looks something like this.
cues.zh: 所以也許會想要像這樣的活化向量。

cues.en: So now the distant past is less relevant than the recent past.
cues.zh: 現在，較久以前的資訊，比較近期的資訊不那麼相關。

cues.en: And in this case, we're not really considering the present moment very much.
cues.zh: 而在這個例子中，我們也不太看重現在這個時間點。

cues.en: Again, these values do not sum to one.
cues.zh: 這些值的總和同樣不是 1。

cues.en: But now, instead of just dividing by the sum, I'm going to take the softmax of these values to get a probability distribution.
cues.zh: 但這次不只是除以總和，而是取這些值的 softmax，得到機率分布。

cues.en: And that probability distribution reflects how much of different past time points get incorporated when making predictions about this future event over here.
cues.zh: 這個機率分布反映了預測這個未來事件時，會納入多少來自各個過去時間點的資訊。

cues.en: Now, I calculated the softmax of this vector and here are the results.
cues.zh: 我對這個向量計算 softmax，結果在這裡。

cues.en: Just note that I truncated and rounded a bit so it would look nice in the slides.
cues.zh: 注意，為了讓投影片好看，我有稍微截短數字並四捨五入。

cues.en: So don't be concerned if these numbers don't add up to exactly one.
cues.zh: 所以如果總和不是剛好等於 1，不用擔心。

cues.en: But that's not the real problem here.
cues.zh: 但真正的問題不在這裡。

cues.en: The real problem here is that suddenly the future has a non-zero information value and why did that happen?
cues.zh: 真正的問題是，未來突然有了非零的資訊值。為什麼會這樣？

cues.en: How did we get from completely ignoring the future?
cues.zh: 原本明明完全忽略未來，

cues.en: By giving it a value of zero and all of a sudden it has a non-zero value?
cues.zh: 把它設成零，怎麼突然就出現非零值？

cues.en: I'm going to say the answer to this question on the next slide, so feel free to pause the video if you want a moment to think about this.
cues.zh: 下一張投影片會公布答案，想先思考的話，可以暫停影片。

cues.en: Well, the answer comes from the natural exponential.
cues.zh: 答案來自自然指數函數。

cues.en: In the softmax function, e to the zero is not zero, e to the zero is one, so the numerical value
cues.zh: softmax 裡的 e 的零次方不是零，而是 1。因此原本的數值

cues.en: might be zero.
cues.zh: 可能是零，

cues.en: But the softmax transformation of that is going to be greater than zero.
cues.zh: 但 softmax 轉換後會大於零。

cues.en: So what's the solution here.
cues.zh: 解法是什麼？

cues.en: What can we do if we want to softmax a set of numbers and guarantee that some of those numbers will be equal to zero?
cues.zh: 如果想對一組數字做 softmax，又保證其中某些結果恰好等於零，該怎麼做？

cues.en: Again, I will answer that question in a moment.
cues.zh: 稍後就會回答。

cues.en: Feel free to pause the video if you want some time to think about it based on what you see in this graph over here.
cues.zh: 如果想根據這張圖先思考一下，可以暫停影片。

cues.en: So the answer comes from the fact that the limit of e to the x as x goes to minus infinity is zero.
cues.zh: 答案是：當 x 趨近負無限大時，e 的 x 次方，其極限為零。

cues.en: If you are not familiar with this limit notation and concept, then basically all of this just means that when x goes to minus infinity, then e to the x goes to zero.
cues.zh: 如果不熟極限的符號與概念，簡單說就是 x 趨近負無限大時，e 的 x 次方會趨近零。

cues.en: That's what you see in this graph over here.
cues.zh: 圖上顯示的就是這件事。

cues.en: And that is our solution.
cues.zh: 這就是解法。

cues.en: So instead of setting future values to be zero we set them to be minus infinity.
cues.zh: 不要把未來的值設成零，而是設成負無限大。

cues.en: And then the softmax of that is zero.
cues.zh: 這樣做 softmax 後，結果就是零。

cues.en: Okay this is great.
cues.zh: 很好。

cues.en: So now we have a way to integrate information over the past with any arbitrary weightings and activation
cues.zh: 現在有方法可以用任意權重與活化值，整合過去的資訊，

cues.en: values, while ignoring the future by setting it equal to zero in the softmax.
cues.zh: 同時讓未來在 softmax 結果中為零，從而忽略未來。

cues.en: So and by softmax we also guarantee a probability distribution, and this increases the likelihood of numerical stability as well as a little bit of sparsity in the activations.
cues.zh: 而且 softmax 保證結果形成機率分布，這有助於數值穩定，也讓活化值具有一些稀疏性。

cues.en: I'll talk more about that towards the end of the video.
cues.zh: 影片結尾還會多談一點。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So this is fine.
cues.zh: 這樣沒問題。

cues.en: How is any of this actually used in practice.
cues.zh: 但實務上到底怎麼使用？

cues.en: Let's consider that in language models the model isn't just making one prediction about one token into the future.
cues.zh: 想想看，語言模型並不是只預測未來的一個詞元。

cues.en: Every time the model processes a token, it's trying to predict what the next token will be.
cues.zh: 每次模型處理某個詞元，都試著預測下一個詞元。

cues.en: And of course, text has many tokens, which means we need to repeat this procedure repeatedly.
cues.zh: 而文字有很多詞元，因此必須反覆進行這個程序。

cues.en: So here we are in the present moment, and we are trying to use information that we've integrated from the past in order to make a prediction about the future.
cues.zh: 現在我們處於當下，想利用整合自過去的資訊，預測未來。

cues.en: But once we get to the future, then we are again in the present moment and also trying to predict the future.
cues.zh: 但到了原本的未來，那又成了新的當下，仍然要繼續預測未來。

cues.en: So we need a way to represent the time causality vectors in a way that captures this repeated flow over time.
cues.zh: 因此需要一種表示時間因果向量的方式，來涵蓋這個隨時間不斷重複的過程。

cues.en: Now we can do that with a bunch of individual vectors and a for loop.
cues.zh: 可以用許多獨立向量，加上一個 for 迴圈來做。

cues.en: And that's not terrible.
cues.zh: 這樣也不差。

cues.en: You know, some of my best friends use for loops, but matrices turn out to be a much better, more elegant, and also more computationally efficient method.
cues.zh: 我的一些好朋友也用 for 迴圈，但矩陣其實是更好、更優雅，而且計算更有效率的方法。

cues.en: So we can accomplish this time causality mask using a matrix that looks something like this.
cues.zh: 因此可以用像這樣的矩陣，實現時間因果遮罩。

cues.en: So now each row corresponds to a different vector of time points.
cues.zh: 每一列對應一個包含不同時間點的向量。

cues.en: So in the first row we are in time point one trying to predict time point two.
cues.zh: 第一列表示，我們位於時間點 1，試著預測時間點 2。

cues.en: In the second row we are in time point two trying to predict time point three based on information from time point two.
cues.zh: 第二列表示，位於時間點 2，根據時間點 2 的資訊預測時間點 3，

cues.en: And also what we have accrued from time point one and so on, down all the rows and across time.
cues.zh: 以及從時間點 1 累積的資訊；如此逐列、隨時間繼續。

cues.en: So now when we get to the fifth row, the present moment is at the end of this vector.
cues.zh: 到了第五列，當下就位於這個向量的最後。

cues.en: And so we are trying to predict time point six, which I'm not actually depicting in this matrix, but
cues.zh: 因此我們試著預測時間點 6，雖然這個矩陣沒有畫出它，

cues.en: this would be a prediction about the future based on all the past tokens and activations.
cues.zh: 但這仍然是根據所有過去詞元與活化值，預測未來。

cues.en: So this matrix shows Unscaled values, and you already know from the previous few slides that we want these numbers scaled so that they sum to one.
cues.zh: 矩陣顯示的是尚未縮放的值；從前幾張投影片已經知道，我們希望縮放這些數字，讓總和為 1。

cues.en: And we also want to softmax them.
cues.zh: 也希望對它們做 softmax。

cues.en: No problem.
cues.zh: 沒問題。

cues.en: We just changed the matrix to look like this.
cues.zh: 只要把矩陣改成這樣。

cues.en: And then we can softmax.
cues.zh: 接著就能做 softmax。

cues.en: And to be clear we softmax each row individually.
cues.zh: 說清楚一點，是對每一列各自做 softmax。

cues.en: So we're not softmax ING down the columns.
cues.zh: 不是沿著每一欄往下做。

cues.en: We're not softmax ING the entire matrix all at once.
cues.zh: 也不是把整個矩陣一次拿去做 softmax。

cues.en: It's softmax over each row individually.
cues.zh: 而是逐列各自做 softmax。

cues.en: But why do we even need to softmax.
cues.zh: 但為什麼一定要做 softmax？

cues.en: What is the point?
cues.zh: 目的何在？

cues.en: What is the advantage of softmax?
cues.zh: 對矩陣的列做 softmax，

cues.en: The rows in the matrix.
cues.zh: 有什麼好處？

cues.en: And why don't we just divide by the sum of all the activation values and leave the feature values at zero instead of minus infinity?
cues.zh: 為什麼不直接除以所有活化值的總和，並讓未來值維持零，而不是負無限大？

cues.en: Again, I'm going to give two answers to this question.
cues.zh: 這個問題會給兩個答案。

cues.en: Why we want to have softmax in this causal attention mechanism.
cues.zh: 也就是為什麼希望因果注意力機制裡有 softmax。

cues.en: And feel free to pause the video if you want a moment to think about it.
cues.zh: 想先思考的話，可以暫停影片。

cues.en: Okay, so one answer is that the activation values can be negative.
cues.zh: 第一個答案是，活化值可能為負。

cues.en: Here I depicted everything as positive numbers, but activation values can be negative.
cues.zh: 這裡全部畫成正數，但活化值也可能是負的。

cues.en: You will learn in a few videos from now what these activation values actually correspond to.
cues.zh: 再過幾支影片，就會知道這些活化值實際對應什麼。

cues.en: But basically they are dot products between vectors representing contextual information from different tokens.
cues.zh: 基本上，它們是向量之間的內積，這些向量代表來自不同詞元的上下文資訊。

cues.en: So softmax takes care of that Negativity by making all the numbers be non-negative.
cues.zh: softmax 會把所有數字變成非負值，因此能處理負數的問題。

cues.en: A second answer is that the softmax transform is also useful, because it pushes the relatively large values to be even bigger compared to the rest of the distribution.
cues.zh: 第二個答案是，softmax 也很有用，因為它會讓相對較大的值，比起分布中的其餘值更加突出。

cues.en: So that promotes a little bit of sparsity, which is actually a good thing in a language model.
cues.zh: 這會促進一些稀疏性，而這對語言模型有好處。

cues.en: So as you are continuously processing each token throughout all the transformers and the residual stream
cues.zh: 當你持續透過各個 Transformer、殘差串流

cues.en: and so on, you want to narrow the search space of possible tokens that you can select and start focusing
cues.zh: 等元件處理每個詞元時，會希望縮小可選詞元的搜尋空間，逐漸聚焦

cues.en: in on a smaller number of relevant tokens, while suppressing the probability of all the irrelevant tokens from being selected.
cues.zh: 在較少數的相關詞元，同時壓低所有不相關詞元被選中的機率。

cues.en: Softmax is one way to nudge the algorithm towards preferring a small number of tokens.
cues.zh: softmax 是引導演算法偏好少數詞元的一種方式。

cues.en: Okay, one final point in this video.
cues.zh: 好，這支影片最後再談一點。

cues.en: You know, uh, in the real world, we cannot exactly know what's going to happen in the future because it hasn't happened yet.
cues.zh: 現實世界裡，我們無法確切知道未來會發生什麼，因為事情還沒發生。

cues.en: But when we're training a language model on text, the text has already been written.
cues.zh: 但用文字訓練語言模型時，文字已經寫好了。

cues.en: So at each token position, we actually do have access to what happens in the future in the text.
cues.zh: 所以在每個詞元位置，我們其實都能取得文字後面發生的內容。

cues.en: So why not use those future values to help train the model?
cues.zh: 為什麼不利用這些未來值來幫助訓練模型？

cues.en: Wouldn't that be better?
cues.zh: 不是會更好嗎？

cues.en: And wouldn't it be more efficient because the model can incorporate more context?
cues.zh: 模型能納入更多上下文，不是也更有效率嗎？

cues.en: So it turns out that this causal mask is characteristics of models that are designed to generate new text.
cues.zh: 原來，這種因果遮罩是為了產生新文字而設計的模型所具有的特徵。

cues.en: So when you're generating new text, you don't yet know what's going to happen in the future.
cues.zh: 因為產生新文字時，你還不知道後面會發生什麼。

cues.en: So you only can use the information from the past to make predictions about the future.
cues.zh: 只能利用過去的資訊來預測未來。

cues.en: On the other hand, if you want to train a language model that can read an existing text and perform
cues.zh: 另一方面，如果想訓練能閱讀現有文字，並進行

cues.en: a classification analysis or a sentiment analysis or summarize the text.
cues.zh: 分類分析、情緒分析，或文字摘要的語言模型，

cues.en: Then knowing the future is really helpful because there's a lot of information in later parts of a text that can help you understand the earlier parts of a text.
cues.zh: 那麼知道後面的內容就很有幫助，因為文字後半段的許多資訊，可以協助理解前半段。

cues.en: So in models like Bert, there is no causal mask, there's only the one missing token, and the model
cues.zh: 所以像 BERT 這類模型沒有因果遮罩，只有那個被遮住的詞元，模型

cues.en: can leverage information from all the other tokens in the context, including tokens that come after the missing token.
cues.zh: 可以利用上下文中所有其他詞元的資訊，包括出現在被遮住詞元之後的詞元。

cues.en: To maximize the information, it gets to predict one missing token.
cues.zh: 藉此取得最多資訊，預測那個被遮住的詞元。

cues.en: Understanding this causal attention mask will help you understand how GPT are trained and how the attention mechanism works.
cues.zh: 了解這個因果注意力遮罩，有助於理解 GPT 如何訓練，以及注意力機制如何運作。

cues.en: Okay.
